title: Union MSME Minister Shri Jitan Ram Manjhi to Inaugurate NSSH Office and Preside over National SC-ST Hub Conclave in Raipur
subtitle: Opening New Doors for SC-ST Entrepreneurs: National SC-ST Hub Conclave to be Held in Raipur
body_text: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India is organizing ‘National SC-ST Hub Conclave’ on 28 th November, 2026, at Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Auditorium, Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The purpose of the Conclave is to promote entrepreneurship and spread awareness about the National SC-ST Hub Scheme and other MSME initiatives and to support, encourage existing/aspiring entrepreneurs of the State.  The event will bring together major stakeholders viz. CPSEs, Banks, Financial Institutions, GeM and State Government which are working towards development of MSMEs and extend handholding support.  It will also provide a platform to interact with aspiring/existing SC/ST entrepreneurs, CPSEs, Industry Associations, lending institutions to enhance participation of SC/ST Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in public procurement. The Conclave will be presided over by Shri Jitan Ram Manjhi, Union Minister of MSME, in the presence of Shri Guru Khushwant Saheb, Minister of Scheduled Caste Development, Skill Development, Technical Education and Employment, Govt. of Chhattisgarh and Shri Lakhan Lal Dewangan, Minister of Commerce and Industries Govt. of Chhattisgarh . The Conclave will also be attended by  Shri Purandar Mishra, Member of Legislative Assembly and Senior officers of Central & State Governments. The Public Procurement Policy for MSEs of Central Government, mandates that Central Ministries, Departments, and PSUs shall procure at least 25% of their annual requirements from MSEs, including 4% from SC/ST-owned MSEs and 3% from women-owned MSEs. “National SC-ST Hub (NSSH) Scheme” was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in October 2016 with the objective of augmenting the capacity of SC/ST entrepreneurs and to empower them to participate in public procurement process and to fulfil the mandated target of 4% public procurement from SC/ST owned MSEs. Several initiatives have been undertaken under NSSH to boost entrepreneurship among SC/STs in capacity building, market linkage, finance facilitation, tender bid participation, etc. To ease the access to latest technology, under Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy, 25% subsidy (upto Rs. 25 lakh) is provided to SC/ST MSEs engaged in manufacturing and service Sectors for procurement of Plant & Machinery/ Equipment on institutional finance. Since inception of the Scheme in October 2016, there has been 36 fold increase in public procurement from SC/ST MSE in FY 2025-26. To further expand the outreach of the NSSH Scheme in the State of Chhattisgarh, a NSSH Office is being inaugurated at Kachna, Raipur. The office will serve as a dedicated facilitation centre to provide handholding support, guidance and assistance to SC/ST-owned MSEs in the State, enabling them to avail the benefits of the Scheme and enhance their participation in public procurement. To facilitate SC/ST MSEs for registration on GeM and Udgam Portal, dedicated stalls will be available at the Conclave venue where they can onboard on GeM and Udyam Portal. MSME sector plays a significant role in terms of job creation and improving livelihood. The Sector consists of more than 10.19 crore enterprises employing over 31 crore people contributing significantly to the growth of the nation with nearly 30% of contribution to GDP and over 45% of overall exports from India. The Government implements several schemes and programmes to strengthen and empower MSME sector in the country including Chhattisgarh, which inter-alia include Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme, PM Vishwakarma, Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises, Micro and Small Enterprises-Cluster Development Programme, Entrepreneurship Skill Development Programme,  Procurement and Marketing Support Scheme, International Cooperation Scheme, Tool Rooms, Technology Centre System Programme, MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme, registration for MSMEs on Udyam Registration Portal, etc. Chhattisgarh is a mineral-rich State and an important industrial hub. In addition, the State's  agricultural and forest resources offer considerable potential for the growth of food processing, forest-based industries and MSMEs. By taking advantage of Central Government initiatives, the people of Chhattisgarh can generate employment and build better livelihoods. The event will provide an interactive platform for aspiring and existing entrepreneurs to get awareness about various schemes and initiatives of Ministry of MSME, Government of India in alignment with the national vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. A significant number of entrepreneurs from Raipur and surrounding regions are expected to participate in the event. *** PC/KG
